states: Actual App with safe HTTP fixtures: security status detailLevel=privileged and requiresAuth=true, matching the native producer semantics rather than granting new scopes. Chromium desktop and mobile Chrome/Pixel 5; Playwright 1.56.1.

Complete registered TrueNAS/Ceph threshold, VMware/TrueNAS/Apprise TLS-warning and powered-off tolerance cases on desktop; the five applicable cases also pass on mobile Chrome. Desktop-only TrueNAS threshold case is skipped on mobile as registered.
interactions: Live threshold tabs and Ceph row controls render; keyboard expansion excludes collapsed controls from focus. Apprise warning checkbox works and retains its persistent warning. Powered-off policy preserves inheritance, explicit zero and strict validation. No server permission, grant or production TLS change.

Desktop Apprise and narrow Notifications captures opened natively with view_image: readable existing controls after authenticated admission. The narrow capture depicts the external-watchdog card rather than the offscreen Apprise warning; TLS-warning visibility is separately asserted in the registered browser test.

Initial desktop batch: five passes and one evidence-fixture error boundary caused by an empty external-watchdog state object; adding the native disabled-state discriminator permits only the unfinished Apprise case to pass. No source relaxation. WebKit launch-flag error and subsequent remaining cases are retained separately; neither is represented as a product pass. Full source execution and native/account recovery remain separate.
